कुण् (श) कुणति 6.
a. To sound;
to cherish; to be in pain. (क)
कोणयति 10.
a. To converse with,
to counsel, or advice.

कूण् (ञ-क) कूणयति ते 10.
c. To
contract or close.

कुणप (पः-पी) 1.
m. n. A dead body.
m. Foetor; a spear.
f. (पी) A
Maina. a. Foul, stinking.

कुणाल (लः) 1.
m. Name of a country.

कुणि (णिः) 1.
m. A cripple with a
crooked or withered arm.

कूणि (णिः-णिः-णि)
a. Crooked-armed.

कुणिन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. A sound; sounding.

कुण्टक (कः-का-कं)
a. Fat.

कुण्ठ (ण्ठः-ण्ठा-ण्ठं)
a. Idle, stupid.

कुण्ठक (कः-का-कं)
a. A fool, stupid.

कुण्ठित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Grasped; en-
circled; stupid; harmless.

कुण्ड (ण्डः-ण्डा) 1.
m. f. A son or
daughter born in adultery.
m. f.
A pitcher.
f. Student's water-
pot.
n. Hole for consecrated fire.

कुण्ड-कीट (टः) 1.
m. A follower of
the
Chārvāka doctrine, denying
the
Vedas; a bastard, a keeper
of slaves or concubines.

कुण्ड-कील (लः) 1.
m. Man of low birth.

कुण्ड-गोल (लः) 1.
m. Sour gruel.

कुण्ड-गोलक (कः) 1.
m. Sour rice gruel.

कुण्डङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. An arbour.

कुण्ड-पाय्य (य्यः) 1.
m. A sacrifice.

कुण्ड-पाय्यवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Of-
fering a sacrifice or oblation.

कुण्डल (लं-ला) 1.
n. An ear-ring,
bracelet, fetter.
f. Mountain ebony.

कुण्डल-धारण (णं) 1.
n. The wearing
of ear-rings, &c.

कुण्डल-धारिन् (री-रिणी-रि)
a. Wear-
ing ear-rings or bracelets, &c.

कुण्डलिन् (ली) 1.
m. A name of
Varu-
na; a snake; a peacock; a spot-
ted deer.
a. Having ear-rings.

कुण्डा-शिन् (शी-शिनी-शि)
a. Support-
ed by adulterous offspring.

कुण्डिका (का) 1.
f. A student's wa-
ter pot, a pitcher.

कुण्डिन (नं) 1.
n. A city;
Vidarbha. plu.
its people.
m. Name of a sage.

कुण्डिन् (ण्डी) 5.
m. A bastard.

कुण्डीर (रः) 1.
m. A man.
a. Able.

कुण्डो_ध्नी (ध्नी) 3.
f. Large-uddered cow.

कूणिका (का) 1.
f. The horn of any
animal; peg of a lute.

कूणित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Closed, shut.

कुणक (कः) 1.
m. A young animal.
